description: This Java source file 'UelUtil.java' implements utilities for handling Unified Expression Language (UEL) expressions within the OFBiz framework. It provides methods for evaluating, setting, and removing UEL expressions, as well as managing context and resolvers for expression evaluation. It includes custom ELResolvers and context classes to handle variable resolution, localized maps, and list/map auto-vivification.

classes.name: UelUtil
classes.description: Final utility class providing methods to evaluate and manipulate Unified Expression Language (UEL) expressions within the OFBiz framework.

classes.name: BasicContext
classes.description: ELContext subclass providing context for expression evaluation with mutable variables and fixed resolver and function mapper.

classes.name: ReadOnlyContext
classes.description: ELContext subclass for evaluation in read-only mode, with custom variable resolver.

classes.name: ReadOnlyVariableMapper
classes.description: VariableMapper implementation that provides read-only variable resolution within ReadOnlyContext.

classes.name: BasicVariableMapper
classes.description: VariableMapper to manage variable resolution and assignment within BasicContext.

classes.name: ReadOnlyExpression
classes.description: ValueExpression implementation representing a read-only resolved object.

classes.name: BasicValueExpression
classes.description: ValueExpression for a specific variable name within BasicContext, enabling get/set operations.

classes.name: ExtendedCompositeResolver
classes.description: Custom CompositeELResolver that supports auto-vivification when setting values at null base.

classes.name: ExtendedListResolver
classes.description: Custom ListELResolver supporting 'add' and 'insert' operations, with optional read-only mode.

classes.name: ExtendedMapResolver
classes.description: Custom MapELResolver that handles LocalizedMap types, resolving variables with consideration for locale.

methods.name: evaluate
methods.description: Evaluates a UEL expression in the given context, returning the result.

methods.name: setValue
methods.description: Sets a value in the context based on the provided UEL expression.

methods.name: removeValue
methods.description: Removes (sets to null) the value referenced by a UEL expression in the context.

methods.name: prepareExpression
methods.description: Converts an OFBiz-specific expression syntax into a UEL-compatible expression.

methods.name: getLocalizedMapLocaleKey
methods.description: Returns the constant key used to retrieve the locale from a LocalizedMap.
